_comment: __text baseline for the binary-size CI gate (see devkit size check and .github/workflows/binary_size.yml). Measured osx-arm64, 2026-09-15, on mojo 1.2.0.dev2026091405. Regenerate after an intentional size change with: pixi run -e dev python -m devkit size check --update. Re-recorded for plans that declare their own parameters: one reflected `references` walk replaces `columns()`, `DynRelation.params()` feeds `QueryCli(plan).run()`, and a scan path can be a `param`. query_cli +21,120 (+0.71%) is the program built on it -- the parameter walk, typed token parsers and the late-bound scan path. Every other gate stays flat: query_streaming -4,968 (-0.34%), query_expr2_streaming -4,708 (-0.33%), query_streaming_agg -5,952 (-0.05%), query_dynvalue -5,184 (-0.05%), query_join +856 (+0.05%), query_streaming_agg_fused +1,028 (+0.07%), query_expr2_agg_fused +964 (+0.07%). Deltas are against the parent commit measured on the same machine.
